messages:
zane: Heads-up — I'm seeing a regression in long-context KV growth across architectures after the recent paged-alloc change. MI250x shows sustained memory climb, RTX/H100 show stalls and latency spikes. Dropping traces here.

maria: Saw similar on a customer repro (seq ~70k). Eviction doesn't seem to free PT entries, memory numbers keep increasing. Repro steps?

zane: Repro steps: run paged-attn with batch=1, seq=70k, model fp16 on MI250x with ROCm 5.x, enable kvcache paging. I can upload nvprof/rocprof snapshots.

aj: On H100 we hit long stalls but eventually reclaim; on RTX it reclaims faster but with large token latency spikes. Seems eviction ordering differs.

taylor: I captured PT walk logs + kvcache traces. Looks like shadow alloc stamps diverge when remap happens under heavy reuse. snippet: 

```
[2026-03-18T09:12:23Z] kvcache: alloc page id=0x7f4e size=2MB owner=0x3 stamp=12487
[2026-03-18T09:12:24Z] kvcache: evict page id=0x7f4e queued->inflight
[2026-03-18T09:12:25Z] pt: remap owner=0x2 vs expected=0x3 (mismatch)
[2026-03-18T09:12:25Z] pt: walk kernel returning stale entry -> leak
```

Looks like remap races with eviction completion on some drivers.

perf-bot: Perf job 2026-03-18/kv-page-rotation: mem-growth +23% over 30m; top kernels: pt_walk_kernel, remap_async, evict_task.

zane: @aj @maria attached nvprof/rocprof: kernel selection seems unchanged, the backlog is in the async evict/remap path. Queue lengths spike before mem climbs.

maria: Hypothesis: when reuse window triggers remap into holes, the eviction ordering doesn't preserve a global LRU and we create transient PT holes that never get reclaimed because owner stamps mismatch.

aj: Can we validate by forcing synchronous evict semantics? Quick patch: drain eviction queue before remap and do atomic owner update. If leak stops, it's likely reorder/race.

taylor: I tried a local patch adding a barrier in kvcache_remap() to wait for in-flight evict completions. On RTX: latency +5% but no mem leak in 1h run. Pushed branch: https://git.internal/r/kvcache/remap-barrier (draft).

zane: Nice. Can you run that on MI250x? ROCm reorderings may still show mismatch.

taylor: Starting MI250x run now on ci-perf-07, seq=80k, 2h window. I'll post traces when done.

perf-bot: CI perf job queued: job id 4582 (kvcache/remap-barrier vs main).

aj: If MI250 still leaks we probably need to: 1) preserve owner stamps across remap (generation counter) and 2) make eviction idempotent/coalescing so duplicates don't leave stale PT entries.

maria: Agreed. Proposed next steps: 
1) run taylor branch on MI250x/H100/RTX and collect pt_walk + mem maps 
2) add generation counter on PT entry as a short-term guard 
3) add stronger coalesce in evict path if repro persists

zane: I'll block a small on-call window tomorrow 10:00am PT to cut a hotfix if tests confirm. Adding triage label to issue #1248.

taylor: :thumbsup: I'll drop the MI250 trace link here once complete.

deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for kvcache/remap-barrier at 2026-03-18T11:30:00Z (manual approval queued).

zane: Thanks all — this one correlates with several customer reports. Need to prioritize.
